title: Title of playing music is often elided  in the screen locker
line: The lock screen's media controls now widen to show the song title instead of cutting it off at the password field's width.
explanation: The lock screen puts album art, title, artist and the three playback buttons on one row, and that row filled the Loader under the password field, so it was exactly as wide as the password field. With the buttons taking most of that space, nearly any song title was elided even on a wide screen. The row is now centred under the password field and grows to its natural width when the title needs it, capped at 32 grid units (twice the prompt width) and the window width; short titles keep the old layout.

commits.message:
lockscreen: let media controls grow wider than the password field

The media row was always exactly as wide as the password field, so most
song titles were cut short even with plenty of room on screen. The row
now grows around its centre to fit the title, up to twice that width.

BUG: 485540

patches.diff:
From fd6dab3760933746165f3d9b402a8dae1a648201 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:31:04 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: let media controls grow wider than the password
 field

The media row was always exactly as wide as the password field, so most
song titles were cut short even with plenty of room on screen. The row
now grows around its centre to fit the title, up to twice that width.

BUG: 485540
---
 desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml
index 13bc14f617..4465cd5020 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/MediaControls.qml
@@ -24,7 +24,10 @@ Item {
         RowLayout {
             id: controlsRow
 
-            anchors.fill: parent
+            anchors.top: parent.top
+            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
+            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
+            width: Math.max(parent.width, Math.min(implicitWidth, Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 32, Window.width - Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2))
             spacing: 0
             enabled: model.canControl
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: a long title is cut to 'Bohemian Rhapsody...' next to the buttons.
Fixed: the row widens around its centre and shows far more of the very long title, up to the 32-grid-unit cap.
Master: even 'Bohemian Rhapsody (2011 Remaster)' is elided.
Fixed: the same title is shown in full; the row grows only as much as needed.
